every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal

claims.claim: Samidorphan, a structurally related morphinan sharing the morphinan scaffold and 6-one/14-hydroxy motif with the query, has an absolute oral bioavailability of about 69% (mean 68.6%, range 60.3–82.6%) after a single 2 mg oral dose in healthy volunteers, well above the 20% threshold.

evidence_gaps: No direct oral bioavailability measurement for the query molecule itself is present in the visible records; the decision relies on a structurally related morphinan (samidorphan) and the physicochemical prior.

Samidorphan differs from the query at the N-substituent (cyclopropylmethyl vs methyl) and aromatic substituents (3-hydroxy/3-carboxamide vs 3-methoxy), which could affect metabolism and absorption, though the shared scaffold and high measured F support transfer.
No formulation-specific or dose-ranging data for the query are available in the visible records.
